name: agent-connect
description: Browser SDK bridge for user-owned agent runtimes

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @agent-connect/web && npm run build --workspace @agent-connect/gateway && npm run build --workspace @agent-connect/browser-nonce && npm run build --workspace @agent-connect/firebase-canvas
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:codex-acp-policy && npm run build
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:package:web && npm run test:e2e --workspace @agent-connect/firebase-canvas
